notes.title: Would you like to see DISTRAINT 3?
notes.notes: [p][/p][p]Hey guys! [/p][p][/p][p]DISTRAINT 2 is turning seven years old later this year. Time surely flies by! 😅[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31510650/b72798133b379fd204369124268eb57c3454faa0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]I haven't yet decided what to do next. I've heard people asking for DISTRAINT 3, and quite frankly, it doesn't sound like a horrible idea. My latest releases haven't been selling well enough, so my next game needs to be something that will do well. That said, the timing could be right for DISTRAINT 3 if there's demand from the players.[/p][p][/p][p]One of the players started a petition to gauge the interest. That said, if you would like to see DISTRAINT 3 happen, you could sign the petition and share it with like-minded people: [/p][p][url="https://www.petitions.com/we_the_players_want_distraint_3"]https://www.petitions.com/we_the_players_want_distraint_3[/url][/p][p][/p][p]If this gets enough attention, I'll create DISTRAINT 3. 😎[/p][p][/p][p]EDIT: After reading some of the comments, I'd like to add that I would not continue Mr. Price's story unless I come up with a really good one! DISTRAINT 3 could also be a new story with mostly new characters. Some people are concerned that I'm doing this for the wrong reasons, but let me assure you that's not the case. Whatever I do next is something I want to do, and it has always been that way. ☺️[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers and thanks for all the support![/p][p]Jesse[/p]

notes.title: DISTRAINT 2 2024 Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey folks![/h2]

[h2]STEAMWORKS.MFX[/h2]

It has been a while since the latest update. I've heard from some folks that they were having problems launching the game. I hope this update fixes the missing steamworks.mfx error!

[h2]STEAM DECK[/h2]

While updating, I made the necessary changes for that sweet Steam Deck Verified badge. I will submit DISTRAINT: Deluxe Edition and DISTRAINT 2 for the verification. I've completed both DISTRAINT games with my Steam Deck without any problems, so I believe it is only a matter of time before both games are officially verified.

[h2]FONT[/h2]

Likely, the most significant change I made is updating the font to the fantastic Silver font by Poppy Works. This font supports all languages, although it might miss a word or two in Chinese/Korean/Japanese.
If you have any problems with the font/subtitles or with the game, please let me know via email: makkonen.j.k@gmail.com


[h2]POSSIBLE WINDOWS SCALING BUG[/h2]

While testing, I noticed Windows scaling setting affected font rendering. If you're having a hard time reading the subtitles, please try setting your Windows "Scale" to 100%. You can find this setting from "Display settings" -> "Scale".

Thank you, and happy gaming! :)

Jesse

notes.title: DISTRAINT 2 Releasing 13th of November
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

First, I'd like to thank you for all the support and patience. It has helped me to create this game, thanks! :)

I've finally decided release-date for DISTRAINT 2. Like the title says, 13th of November, exciting!

Now the next part is essential, so please read carefully. Many games are releasing daily, and the competition is fierce. To make it with DISTRAINT 2 and keep developing in the future, I'd appreciate if you could add DISTRAINT 2 to your [u][b]wishlist.[/b][/u]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/743390/DISTRAINT_2/

That's important and an excellent way for me (and perhaps even for Valve?) to check how many people are interested in the game, so please, consider adding to your [u][b]wishlist.[/b][/u] I can't stress this enough.

Okay, how about translations?

Currently, I'm writing the last dialogues in English. I plan to get all the dialogue done within the next two or three weeks, and after that get the game translated into as many languages as possible before the release. I'm still not sure how to approach this, there are already many volunteers, so I might go with them. But like I said, I'll think about how to approach this once I've dialogues ready. That said, I'll try to include as many translations in the release as possible.

Thank you for your support! :)

Jesse

notes.title: DISTRAINT 2 delayed, sorry guys!
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

First, thank you for your patience!

I wanted to release DISTRAINT 2 already last May, but things happened, and I thought it would be August. Well, again a lot of stuff happened in the "real life," things that took away from the time I could use for development. DISTRAINT 2 is now approximately 90% ready, it's really that close, but I don't want to rush it!

I'll take all the time it needs to finalize the game and get it translated into as many major languages as possible. I know for the fact that in two weeks time I can get fully back working, so things will start moving fast from there.

Anyway, late year on Steam is always tricky to release. There are so many sale events that finding the right spot is difficult... However, I will do my best to release as soon as possible, but this could still take a few months.

I hope DISTRAINT 2 will be worth the wait, and again, thank you for your patience! :)

Jesse

notes.title: QA
notes.notes:
[h1]What are the supported languages?[/h1]

Currently only English, but I will most definitely get the game translated into as many languages as possible. All this takes time, so it's hard to say what are the supported languages when releasing. I will update the Steam info accordingly before the release, so you can see what the supported languages are.

[h1]Do I need to play the first game before playing this?[/h1]

I will add "previously in DISTRAINT" so the short answer is no. However, I'd highly suggest playing the first game before. It's usually on sale, so it's quite affordable.

[h1]How about Android and iOS?[/h1]

I'm currently focusing on PC only. However, once DISTRAINT 2 has released on Steam, I will start porting over to Android and iOS. There are some things I can't port over, so I need to make some changes. DISTRAINT 2 won't look the same on Android or iOS, but I'm sure I can figure a way to make it as good as possible.

[h1]How much does the game cost?[/h1]

One million dolla... no, wait!
Probably 7,99 - 8,99 $/€

[h1]How long is the game?[/h1]

Can't say for sure yet, still lots to do!
Depending on how you play, I'd say 2,5-4 hours. Should be longer than the first game. Also, I don't want to make it too long; I rather have settings to change quickly to keep the game fresh.

[h1]Soundtrack?[/h1]

Oh yes! There is a lot more music in DISTRAINT 2, and a lot better too. I might not release it right away, but if there's demand, I'll most definitely release it one way or another.

[h1]Steam achievements and cards?[/h1]

I'll have both, don't worry!

[h1]Where can I follow the progress?[/h1]

I gotta admit, I'm not super active giving daily updates and so. But yeah, the best place would be my Twitter and perhaps Facebook:
[url=https://twitter.com/jesse_makkonen]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/jessemakkonengames/]Facebook[/url]

If I'm missing something, please ask away! :)
